concepts.prompt: Using the reference images for faction style and palette, draft a 3D-model concept of a BROKEN Team Tether wooden road barricade after a battle: a cross-braced X-frame timber barricade (thick dark planks, dark iron brackets and bolts) that was about 3 m wide, now smashed into two separate halves lying apart at angles with a big jagged splintered break in the middle, one half still standing tilted, the other half fallen over. Chipped and flaking oxblood red paint flecks and a scraped oxblood stripe on the planks, a dented iron Team Tether plate. Weathered wood. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game prop, chunky exaggerated readable silhouette that reads clearly from 15 m away, hand-painted PBR look, clean shapes, slightly oversized details. Single isolated object, full object visible and centred, plain neutral background, even lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text.

Using the reference images for faction style and palette, draft a 3D-model concept of a broken Team Tether road barricade after a battle, shown from a three-quarter view. Originally a 3 m wide checkpoint barricade: two heavy X-shaped cross-braced timber trestles joined by two long thick horizontal planks, with dark iron corner brackets and bolts. Now it is smashed in the middle: the two long planks are snapped with jagged splintered ends, so it is in two halves. The left half (one X trestle with its half of the planks) still stands but tilts; the right half has toppled over onto its side on the ground, a small gap between the halves with a few splinters. Weathered dark timber with chipped flaking oxblood red paint stripes and a dented dark iron plate with a ring-and-cross emblem. Compact composition, the two halves close together. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game prop, chunky exaggerated readable silhouette that reads clearly from 15 m away, hand-painted PBR look, clean shapes, slightly oversized details. Single isolated object, full object visible and centred, plain neutral background, even lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text.

agent_visual_verdict: Good: cross-braced dark timber barricade with snapped, splintered planks, oxblood paint stripes and a dented iron plate with the ring-and-cross emblem; the broken plank half lies on the ground beside the tilted standing trestle. Reads broken at distance.
notes: c1 concepts were rejected (inconsistent views, did not read as a barricade). c2 views 0 and 2 used; view 1 rejected. The fallen half is a plank section rather than a full second trestle.
